mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_registration_task (request_id, service_code, country_id, unit_price, quantity, account_group_id, account_type, ip_allocation_mode, ip_region, cancel_requested, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{requestId}, #{serviceCode}, #{countryId}, #{unitPrice}, #{quantity}, #{accountGroupId}, #{accountType}, #{ipAllocationMode}, #{ipRegion}, #{cancelRequested}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

INSERT INTO account_registration_item (task_id, ordinal, state, created_at, updated_at) VALUES
(#{item.taskId}, #{item.ordinal}, #{item.state}, #{item.createdAt}, #{item.updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM account_registration_task ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) pending, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state BETWEEN 2 AND 6 OR state=11 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) processing, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state=7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) succeeded, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state=8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) failed, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state=9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) `unknown`, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN state=10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) cancelled FROM account_registration_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId}
SELECT * FROM account_registration_item WHERE task_id=#{taskId} ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.update: UPDATE account_registration_task SET cancel_requested=1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{taskId}
UPDATE account_registration_item SET state=10,lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=#{now} WHERE task_id=#{taskId} AND state=1
mapper.select: SELECT i.id,i.tenant_id FROM account_registration_item i INNER JOIN account_registration_task t ON t.id=i.task_id AND t.tenant_id=i.tenant_id WHERE (i.state BETWEEN 1 AND 6 OR (i.state=11 AND (i.cancel_after IS NULL OR i.cancel_after <= #{now}))) AND (i.state <> 1 OR (t.cancel_requested=0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM account_registration_item cancelling WHERE cancelling.tenant_id=i.tenant_id AND cancelling.task_id=i.task_id AND cancelling.state=11 ))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN i.state=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,i.id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE account_registration_item SET lease_token=#{item.leaseToken},lease_until=#{item.leaseUntil} WHERE id=#{item.id} AND state=#{item.state} AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until < #{now})
UPDATE account_registration_item SET lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND lease_token=#{token}
